required_outcomes: Recognises that the engineer attended on Wednesday 29/04/2026 (event 021) but no report, work result or invoice has arrived three days later.
Chases Riverside Compliance for the outcome of the visit: what was found, whether the door now closes, whether further work or a quote is needed, and the invoice.
Sets a dated follow-up or hold for the provider's reply.
acceptable_alternatives: Also asking the tenant whether the door now closes.
Noting that the arriving engineer was recorded under a different company name ("Meadow Services").
positive_behaviours: Treats the two identical "No work results" updates as one prompt and sends one chase.
red_flags: Booking a new visit or a different provider before hearing from Riverside.
prohibited_actions: Inventing what the engineer found or that the repair is done.
Recording or paying an invoice that has not arrived.
critical_failures: Closing the request or recording a work result without any report from the provider or the tenant.
